children: Solv Protocol has scheduled an unlock of 159.32 million SOLV for June 2027. The release equals 2.70% of the token's circulating supply and covers allocations for investors, the team, and the ecosystem.
The release lets investors and team members sell tokens from allocations that were previously locked. That adds a block of SOLV held by insiders to the supply that could reach the market.

title: Solv Protocol: 159.32 million SOLV unlocks - Jun 2027
